text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
TANKERS - Farnes - (built 1975) 173,715 dwt sold to Turkish buyers for $6 million.
Pacific Pride - (built 1980) 36,834 dwt sold to Italian buyers $11.25 million and $11.75 million respectively.
CONTAINERS - Luna Maersk - (built 1982) 44,142 dwt sold to Hong Kong buyers for $28 million with five years timecharter at $22,000 daily.
PASSENGER - Renaissance Four - (built 1990) 2,420 dwt sold to Monaco-based buyers for $12 million.
RORO - Samarkand - (built 1986) 17,850 dwt sold at auction in Dunkirk to Greek buyers for $7.02 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
